# Other events

## DELAYED\_EXECUTION { #event-27 }

```aa2m
on DELAYED_EXECUTION
```

This event is fired from other triggers after a delaay. TriggeringCard is the card whose trigger emitted this event. It does not persist between sessions.

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on DELAYED_EXECUTION;
}
```

Native name: Delayed Execution (Other). ID: `event-27`
